verdicts.evidence: Drove it for real against a tree I had prepared (I first staged another verifier's BRIEF.md so a whole-tree checkout would restore it byte-identically instead of emptying it; its md5 75f1c293... was unchanged before and after, and I put its index entry back afterwards). Confirm read 'Discard all 5 changed files in base? This cannot be undone.'. The checkout half is real: CLAUDE.md's marker line was gone from the pod afterwards (grep -c VERIFY-04-REVIEW = 0). The clean half is real: two plain-untracked files (verify-04-review-discard.txt, verify-04-review-staged.txt) were removed from disk. HEAD stayed 8a704fb013061bc02d4a318e2f85404bef8c4665. BUT the screen did not empty: it came back reading 'These changes are running in your preview only. 2 of 2 files will be kept.', count badge 2, state badge still 'Unsaved', and verify-04-review-new.txt was still there at 0 bytes.
verdicts.defect: Discard does not remove intent-to-add files, it truncates them to 0 bytes and leaves them in the index, so they stay listed as changed for ever. 'git checkout -- .' restores an intent-to-add path from the empty blob in the index (git 2.39.5 in the pod - reproduced standalone in /tmp), and 'git clean' skips it because it is in the index. This is not a corner case: extensions.ts fileDiff() runs 'git add -N -- <path>' every time you open a file's diff, so merely LOOKING at a new file on this screen converts it to intent-to-add, and Discard then destroys its contents without removing it. Same for anything staged with real content (verified separately: unticking a 'git add'-ed file and pressing 'Discard 1' left it completely untouched, 35 bytes, still listed). Fix is to reset the named paths out of the index first, e.g. 'git reset -q -- <paths>' before the checkout+clean in discardChanges().

verdicts.evidence: The right-hand 'Why this changed' rail contains: one fixed info banner, a three-row fact table (File / Change / Branch) and the 'Ask about this file' button. The banner is the same sentence for every file - only the bolded filename is interpolated - and it says the assistant explains changes in the workspace terminal, not here. Nothing on the rail is derived from the diff: the only live values are file.path, file.status and branch, all already shown in the file list and masthead. Confirmed by reading pages/review.vue (the .review__explain block is static template, there is no generated prose anywhere in data or computed).
verdicts.defect: There is no plain-language explanation of the change. The design's three headed paragraphs (what was added, what was replaced, what was not touched) are replaced by a static banner plus a restated file/status/branch table. The screen is honest about this rather than faking it, but INTENT.md screen 04 makes 'understand' a requirement, not a nicety, so the promise is unmet.

verdicts.evidence: Change type is right on every row (checked 'added' for BRIEF.md, verify-04-review-new.txt, verify-04-review-staged.txt and 'modified' for CLAUDE.md against git status --porcelain). The numbers shown are real: rows read +34 / +3 -1 / +3, and 'git diff --numstat HEAD' returned 34 0 BRIEF.md, 3 1 CLAUDE.md, 3 0 verify-04-review-staged.txt. But an untracked file shows NO counts at all: verify-04-review-new.txt and verify-04-review-long.txt (220 lines) both rendered an empty stats span while their diffs showed +6 and +220.
verdicts.defect: Line counts are missing for untracked files, and worse they are non-deterministic. changedFiles() gets its numbers from 'git diff --numstat HEAD', which does not see untracked paths, while fileDiff() runs 'git add -N' on whatever file you click. So the same unchanged file shows '' before you open its diff and '+6' after the next reload - observed exactly that for verify-04-review-new.txt. Either add -N in changedFiles too, or count the lines of untracked files directly.

Clicked 'Keep and continue building' in the action bar. URL became /dashboard/barn/editor/base and .mc-editor rendered. 'git status --porcelain' in the pod immediately after was identical to before (all five files still changed, including the 220-line file's full 6712 bytes), and nothing was published - no UIPlugin change and no publish progress anywhere.

Half of the promise holds and half does not. The tick genuinely drives the discard: I unticked only verify-04-review-long.txt (a plain untracked 220-line file), the action button relabelled itself 'Discard 1', I pressed it and accepted the confirm, and in the pod that one file was gone while BRIEF.md, CLAUDE.md, verify-04-review-new.txt and verify-04-review-staged.txt were all untouched - so the checkbox is not collected-and-ignored on that path. The leave-the-screen half does not happen at all: with verify-04-review-long.txt unticked I clicked 'Keep and continue building', and back in the pod the file was still there, 6712 bytes, byte-identical. Returning to the review screen re-ticked every box.
verdicts.defect: Unticking a file only feeds the Discard button's target list; leaving the screen never acts on it. review.vue has no beforeRouteLeave / beforeUnmount hook, and load() unconditionally resets this.kept to every path, so the intent is silently dropped the moment you navigate. Either revert the unticked files on leave, or stop implying that leaving decides anything (the design's wording is 'will be kept').

verdicts.defect: review.vue publish() pushes { name: EDITOR_ROUTE, query: { publish: 'local' } }, but nothing reads that query. grep -rn "query.publish" over pkg/barn: 0 hits; the string "publish: 'local'" is written in pages/review.vue:221 and pages/build-failed.vue:91 and read nowhere. editor.vue only ever reads $route.query.tab (line 124). So the ellipsis promises a confirmation step that does not exist and the button just dumps you on the workspace. Gating, separately: the only condition on the button is :disabled="!count" (file count). Neither sign-off from INTENT.md cross-screen rule 3 is checked anywhere.
